Student Services
You are an NBCC Learner!We are here to support you throughout your time at College.  There are many programs and services available to help you get the most of your NBCC experience.  We offer both in person and online support, Accessibility Services, Career and Wellbeing Counselling, Library Services, Success Coaching, Tutoring and so much more! You can explore them on our website, connect with a Student Success Coach or visit the Student Success Centre on your campus.  And don’t forget… your NBCC experience extends beyond the classroom, so get involved! At NBCC, you are part of a vibrant, diverse and inclusive learning community, and we are committed to providing every student with an engaging, quality learning experience.  Learn more by exploring the NBCC Student Learning Experience Charter (pdf).
Questions?If you have a question about NBCC Student Services, please contact us at success@nbcc.ca or reach out directly to a Student Success Coach.
NBCC’s Early Alert Program & PASSPursuing your dreams at college is exciting!  It can also be a lot of work, and sometimes unexpected challenges may pop up.  Don’t worry— we're here to help!Learn More About NBCC's Early Alert Program & PASS
NBCC’s Early Alert and PASS (Program to Assist Student Success) programs are designed to help us help you.  If we notice that you might need a little extra help, we'll reach out to connect you with a variety of supports to keep you on track! Whether you're facing academic or personal challenges, we offer support like advising, academic coaching, counselling, and referrals to other useful resources.Remember, everyone needs a little help sometimes.  For more information on Early Alert or PASS, reach out to your local Student Success Coach or any member of the Student Services team.New Brunswick Community College (NBCC) is committed to protecting the personal information collected, used, disclosed, and maintained and upholding the privacy rights of all individuals whose personal information and/or personal health information is held or controlled by the College. NBCC will comply with all applicable privacy laws and regulations in the Province of New Brunswick. Information collected via PASS and/or the Early Alert program will only be used to guide program administrators in decisions regarding student supports.
